issues.where: near cloud deck, tiles S, T, and U along the bottom of the frame
issues.what: foreground clouds are long brush-like smudges with flat light and almost no eddies or self-shadow, so the surface reads as digital paint at native size
issues.fix: replace the smudge streaks with smaller turbulent eddies, condensate clumps, and local shadow so the near deck matches a photographic cloud deck

issues.where: crop D, center and lower-left of the disk
issues.what: the lit disk is the same airbrushed smear, fibrous strokes instead of cloud structure; it also shows across the lower-left of image-05.png
issues.fix: break up the directional strokes and add high-frequency cloud texture and shading on the lit disk

issues.where: crop G, faint inner rings right of center, below the bright arc
issues.what: one faint ring strand waves and dips instead of staying a smooth concentric arc
issues.fix: rebuild that strand on the same smooth curve as the neighboring rings

issues.where: Q, shadowed left side of the globe
issues.what: Broad, nested dark arcs pinch around a common point. The almost featureless bands look like a texture wrapped around a pole rather than distinct atmospheric structures.
issues.fix: Rebuild the polar mapping in globe space and carry irregular cloud detail across the dark bands.

issues.what: Fine surface detail collapses into long, parallel diagonal smears, even well away from the grazing-angle horizon.
issues.fix: Correct texture sampling and restore local, multidirectional cloud detail in the foreground.

issues.where: V and W, lower ring arc across the bright star cloud
issues.what: The rings show up as stacked dark strokes over the luminous background, but bright star cores remain largely intact in those strokes, making the arc read like a separate overlay.
issues.fix: Apply the same optical-depth mask to the diffuse background and the stars behind the rings, then blend the ring edges with the same sampling as the background.

issues.where: B and H, where the outer ring meets the cyan horizon
issues.what: The thin bright outer contour remains nearly uniform right up to a conspicuous endpoint at the haze.
issues.fix: Feather the ring contrast through the atmospheric glare before the ring is fully occluded.

issues.where: C and I, upper and right illuminated limb
issues.what: A narrow clipped-looking white outline sits inside the broader cyan halo, giving the limb a traced edge.
issues.fix: Reduce the peak rim intensity and give it a continuous falloff into the surrounding glow.

issues.where: J and L, dark sky outside the rings
issues.what: Several brighter stars resolve into short colored flecks instead of compact points.
issues.fix: Render the bright stars with compact, antialiased cores and keep color confined to the core and immediate bloom.
